title: Random UI/UX Design Tip To Save Time and Usage - How do You do it?
author: One_Salty_Pigeon
selftext:
TLDR: Ask claude to create your UI in html first to make testing faster and limit usage rates. Also give game menu examples you want it to use for inspiration. Also would love some tips and ideas as well.  
  
**THIS IS VERY MUCH A WORK IN PROGRESS for a game I'm making.**

But not sure how you guys do UI even with AI etc. But one thing I actually like to do is first have it do the UI in html before I implement it into the game. So Claude took a screenshot of the game and then created the build menu around it. I've noticed if you have it build the UI in html etc first it does  a MUCH better job and uses much less usage then if you have it do it- in the game. 

Another small tip that I've found works well is giving it examples of what you'd like it to use for inspiration etc. But between those two things I've managed to make some semi decent UI changes to my game so far even if it's still very much a work in progress.

One note on this I work in unity and so this advice might vary depending on what type of game you're building

comments.body: I would love to know tips. I have thought of doing Photoshop UI mock ups first.

replies.author: One_Salty_Pigeon
replies.body: Figma might honestly be your best bet to do mockups and going that route is probably best if you have the time + everything already in you head etc. One thing I will say to is GPT Astra is AMAZING at making Icons for the UI stuff so if you're not good at that stuff then it might help. Ofc there's always things like vecteezy etc as well.
